schema_compatibility_rules: CQS, SRP, BudgetEnvelope, and producer IntegrationBinding must each declare schema_version 0.1.
All required structural fields must be present with the expected JSON types.
Unknown or semantically ambiguous authority pairings are not guessed.
The generated consumer binding and MAFS requirement must validate against Package C schemas.
stale_state_rules: Every upstream artifact hash and ID edge must match the supplied predecessor bytes.
The producer IntegrationBinding source chain must match all supplied artifacts.
A producer binding marked non-current is rejected.
No partial consumer requirement set is returned after any stale-chain failure.
authority_preservation_rules: SRP remains evidence-obligation and route-requirement authority.
BudgetEnvelope remains resource and activation authority.
MAFS scientific route cognition begins only after an accepted receipt.

failure_states.INCOMPATIBLE: Configured CQC or current MAFS accepted SHA differs from the contract pins.
failure_states.STALE_SOURCE_CHAIN: An artifact lineage ID/hash edge or producer stale-state declaration is not current.
failure_states.UNSUPPORTED_PRODUCER_BASELINE: Producer binding does not carry the supported historical P1.5 repository and commit.
failure_states.MISSING_REQUIRED_ARTIFACT: A required artifact path is absent.
failure_states.HASH_MISMATCH: An artifact-internal content identity does not match its bytes.
failure_states.SCHEMA_INCOMPATIBLE: A required schema/version/field/type cannot be mapped unambiguously.
failure_states.AUTHORITY_MAPPING_INVALID: SRP requirement status and BudgetEnvelope activation cannot be mapped without changing authority.
